productionIncident.visibleFailure: The only ZIP button said Needs attention even though the finalizer reported export passed with 38 checked files and zero failures.

rootCauses.finding: Continuation prompts did not preserve the prior lesson identity boundary and admitted the same three topics repeatedly.
rootCauses.response: Continuation parsing, route identity, duplicate candidate admission, renumbering, and rejected-topic feedback are explicit compiler contracts.

rootCauses.finding: Fifteen rich lesson contracts each retried incomplete structural fields, producing 38 stream retries after useful facts had already appeared.
rootCauses.response: Scion requests compact fact ledgers, retains stronger complete sections across attempts, freezes admitted facts, and lets deterministic projection own presentation structure.

rootCauses.finding: The Genetics run loaded a biology shard with zero lesson-concept overlap; the new Environmental Chemistry request previously had no source-specific shard.
rootCauses.response: Source selection is discipline-aware and Environmental Chemistry now has an EPA-anchored genome shard with verified manifest hashes.

rootCauses.finding: A content-review blocker disabled archive download even after every physical file check passed.
rootCauses.response: Publish readiness stays fail-closed while verified archive exportability is recovered independently, including persisted V0.16.61-V0.16.63 receipts.

rootCauses.finding: Long assessment titles leaked into sentences, thumbnails severed words, equivalent materials duplicated, and generic feedback/distractor templates repeated across lessons.
rootCauses.response: Identity labels and prose references are separated, thumbnail compaction is word-safe, material identity is canonicalized, and lesson-aware variants pass 5/8/14-lesson stress audits.
